parityBaseline: starci-academy CourseDetailPage at mtp/9a1934231, rendered in production at academy.starci.org/vi/courses/fullstack-mastery

workItems.owns: the /courses/[displayId] route, its hero and trust strip, its narrative sections and the single buy rail
workItems.note: Net-new: no route, no single-course query and no course-detail component exists in the target.

evidence.claim: The target has no /courses/[slug] route; its router holds authentication, dashboard and profile only.

evidence.source: starci-academy-fe/src grep for query-course and coursePricePreview
evidence.claim: The target has no single-course query and no price-preview call; only the paginated list query exists.
CourseRequest accepts id OR displayId, so the production slug fullstack-mastery resolves with no new backend field.
The legacy page is one grid from the top: hero at cols 1-2 row 1, pricing rail at col 3 spanning rows 1-2, narrative at cols 1-2 row 2, plus a mobile-only sticky enroll bar.

The rail is the only buy box on the page — cover, headline price with one discount, one scarcity line, phase ladder, CTA cluster, enrolled-count proof — and the hero deliberately carries no price or CTA.
The five trust chips are derived client-side by walking modules to contents to challenges and minutesRead, so the page must fetch the whole module tree but needs no backend counter.
rail-then-main exists and already carries sticky, top-6, max-h-rail and overflow-y-auto, but it sizes and sticks its FIRST child, so unchanged reuse places the rail on the left.
The target's branches are PressableTree, SurfaceCard, SurfaceFormCard, SurfaceListCard, SurfacePanel and Tree. There is no accordion branch.
profile-topic-chip-run is a badge run with exactly the trust strip's mechanics but is domain-named for profile.

md:[&>*:last-child]:w-72, md:[&>*:last-child]:shrink-0, md:[&>*:first-child]:min-w-0 and md:[&>*:first-child]:grow are all members, so a mirrored right-rail contract is typeable without widening the class vocabulary.

unknowns: The target must add a single-course query carrying the full module tree before any of this renders; this Plan does not size that document.

The legacy curriculum discloses through ModuleAccordionItem, but the target has no accordion branch. Whether the curriculum discloses or stays a flat list is an open decision inside the selected direction.
Cart and checkout are absent from the target, so the CTA's destination beyond enrolment is unproven.
Whether the mobile sticky enroll bar is reproduced as a second owner or folded into the rail.

directions.primaryCta: The rail's single enrol or continue action
readingOrder: sticky buy rail alongside from the top
tradeoffs: The buy decision lives in exactly one place and follows the reader down a long curriculum.
It needs a mirrored layout contract and the most new vocabulary of the three directions.

contracts.why: The payable price leads while original price and discount qualify that same commerce fact on one wrapping line.
A narrow persistent column beside the flexible main measure, already carrying the sticky mechanics — but it owns its FIRST child, which is why parity needs a mirror rather than this key.
The narrative owns the flexible measure while the purchase decision keeps a fixed sticky column at the trailing edge.
The phases are one mutually exclusive ladder where the open phase is the price and the others are the cost of waiting, so they read as one control rather than separate facts.
A course's trust counts are compact peer facts that wrap together; mechanically identical to profile-topic-chip-run but not the same domain.

vocabularyProposals.api: classes: flex, flex-col, gap-6, md:flex-row, md:items-start, md:[&>*:first-child]:min-w-0, md:[&>*:first-child]:grow, md:[&>*:last-child]:w-72, md:[&>*:last-child]:shrink-0, md:[&>*:last-child]:sticky, md:[&>*:last-child]:top-6, md:[&>*:last-child]:self-start, md:[&>*:last-child]:max-h-rail, md:[&>*:last-child]:overflow-y-auto

vocabularyProposals.name: LayoutClassName
vocabularyProposals.api: add md:[&>*:last-child]:sticky, md:[&>*:last-child]:top-6, md:[&>*:last-child]:self-start, md:[&>*:last-child]:max-h-rail, md:[&>*:last-child]:overflow-y-auto

amendments.claimAsWritten: Every class listed is already a member of the locked LayoutClassName union; the union is not widened.
amendments.correction: False. The locked union at src/components/contracts/index.ts lines 50-52 carries md:[&>*:first-child]:sticky, :top-6, :self-start, :max-h-rail and :overflow-y-auto — the FIRST-child forms only. There is no last-child equivalent, so a right-hand sticky rail cannot be typed today. main-then-rail therefore widens the union by five mirrored members.
amendments.evidence: grep of the LayoutClassName union and of rail-then-main at line 1139 in the locked target
amendments.consequenceForApply: Apply must add five members to a governed type, not only a registry entry. The selected direction, its thesis and its reading order are unchanged; only the size of the vocabulary change grew.
